title: The Globe Of The Earth From Brief Testimony To The Formula Of The 3rd Degree Of The 1st Station

questions.question: What does the earth do in this passage?
questions.answer: It shows that Allah is One and truly exists.

questions.question: Does the passage speak only about the soil, or about everything on the earth too?
questions.answer: It speaks about the earth and all that is in it and on it.

questions.question: What is one job named in the passage that Allah does for the earth?
questions.answer: He takes care of it.

questions.question: What does the passage say about seeds?
questions.answer: They are spread around.

questions.question: What happens to living things in this passage?
questions.answer: They are given what they need to live.

questions.question: What two caring qualities of Allah are named?
questions.answer: Compassion and mercy.

questions.question: Are Allah’s mercy and compassion for just a few living things or for all?
questions.answer: They are for all.

questions.question: If the earth shows so many ordered jobs being done, what does that help the traveler understand?
questions.answer: It helps him understand that Allah is in control.

questions.question: What is the main message of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The whole earth points to Allah’s oneness, power, care, and mercy.

questions.question: Who is being spoken about with the words “There is no god but Allah”?
questions.answer: Allah.

questions.question: What big witness is giving a message in this passage?
questions.answer: The earth is giving the message.

questions.question: What other things join the earth in this witness?
questions.answer: Everything in it and on it.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about how seeds are handled?
questions.answer: They are given out in an arranged way.

questions.question: Why is giving life to living things an important sign?
questions.answer: It shows great power and care.

questions.question: What can a child learn from the words about mercy being wide and general?
questions.answer: Allah’s kindness reaches everywhere.

questions.question: Does the passage describe a messy world or an ordered world?
questions.answer: An ordered world.

questions.question: What belief should grow from reading this passage?
questions.answer: Belief that Allah alone is the true God.

questions.question: What part of creation is especially talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The earth.

questions.question: According to the passage, what does the earth testify to?
questions.answer: It testifies to Allah’s necessary existence and oneness.

questions.question: Name another way Allah cares for life that is listed here.
questions.answer: He protects them.

questions.question: Why are seeds mentioned in the passage?
questions.answer: Because their spreading is one sign of wise planning.

questions.question: What does the passage show about Allah’s care for living things?
questions.answer: His care reaches all living things.

questions.question: How do compassion and mercy help us understand the passage?
questions.answer: They show that Allah cares kindly for creation.

questions.question: If someone sees care, order, and protection all over the earth, what should that person think?
questions.answer: That Allah is the One caring for it all.

questions.question: What is the best short summary of this passage?
questions.answer: The earth and all on it show Allah’s oneness and loving care.

questions.question: In this passage, what is the traveler understanding from the earth?
questions.answer: He understands that the earth points to Allah.

questions.question: Is the witness in the passage small and narrow or great and wide?
questions.answer: It is great and wide.

questions.question: What does the passage say about caring for animate beings?
questions.answer: They are given life and cared for.

questions.question: What are animate beings?
questions.answer: Living things.

questions.question: What does “universal” mercy mean?
questions.answer: Mercy for everyone and everything.

questions.question: Why does the passage list many jobs like caring, protecting, and feeding?
questions.answer: To show that Allah’s rule covers all parts of life.

questions.question: What kind of picture of the earth does this give us?
questions.answer: A place run with wisdom and care.

questions.question: What should a Muslim child remember most from this passage?
questions.answer: Allah alone made, manages, and mercifully cares for the earth.

questions.question: What does the passage say the earth proves?
questions.answer: It proves Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: Does the passage talk about one kind of care or many kinds of care?
questions.answer: It talks about many kinds of care.

questions.question: Which word in the passage shows things are kept safe?
questions.answer: Protection.

questions.question: Why is managing the earth important in the passage?
questions.answer: It shows that everything is under control.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the way seeds are spread?
questions.answer: It is done with order and purpose.

questions.question: If mercy is general and all-around, who can receive it?
questions.answer: All living things can receive it.

questions.question: How can the earth be like a sign for people?
questions.answer: By showing Allah’s power, care, and wisdom.

questions.question: What feeling might this passage give a believer?
questions.answer: Trust in Allah.

questions.question: What is one full-sentence lesson from this passage?
questions.answer: The earth is full of signs that Allah alone cares for all creation.

questions.question: What is the biggest truth being said in this passage?
questions.answer: Only Allah is God.

questions.question: What created world is named as a witness to that truth?
questions.answer: The earth.

questions.question: Does the witness include only what is inside the earth, or also what is on it?
questions.answer: It includes both what is in it and what is on it.

questions.question: What does the passage show about raising and caring for living things?
questions.answer: Allah does it.

questions.question: What simple idea does “distribution of seeds” teach?
questions.answer: Seeds are placed where they need to go.

questions.question: What does “administration” tell us about the world?
questions.answer: It is run in an organized way.

questions.question: What can we infer from the many different actions listed together?
questions.answer: One Lord is in charge of all of them.

questions.question: Why would the traveler call this truth something that can be observed?
questions.answer: Because its signs can be seen in the world.

questions.question: How would you explain this passage to a friend in one short sentence?
questions.answer: The earth and all life on it show that Allah is One and cares for everything.
